Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This is a highly specialized experiment focusing on peptide splicing (PCPS). Standard bottom-up pipelines will fail because the target analytes (spliced peptides) are non-contiguous and do not match standard protein databases. Reanalysis requires a de novo sequencing approach followed by a custom splicing algorithm to map fragments back to the precursor polypeptides.
